reviews.text: Great experience from start to finish will all who helped care for my Elli!

I have three dogs that I have taken to World of Animals since they were 8 weeks old.  They have received excellent care from a very loving crew of people who work as a team from the receptionist to the nurses , techs and physicians.  They take the time to talk to you and ask you questions as well as answer your questions.  I really appreciate the regular follow up and genuine concern they have for my precious dogs.
Love how they take such good care of my furry friends. I've been coming here for years and will continue as long as I get this amazing service.

WOA has been A staple in my pet life for the last five years.I recently had the pleasure of experiencing the incredible care at World of Animals in South Philadelphia, and I can confidently give them a five-star review. From the moment we walked in, I felt the genuine compassion and dedication every member of the team has for their patients. They truly go above and beyond to ensure that each furry friend, especially elderly pets, receives the highest level of care and concern.

My 15-year-old Chihuahua Mini Pincher mix (Flo) experienced her first seizure a few months ago. As a pet parent witnessing this for the first time, my heart sank, and I feared the worst. The team at World of Animals immediately stepped in with expert guidance, reassurance, and a treatment plan that made all the difference. Over the last few months, my pup has shown steady improvement, and I can wholeheartedly say it’s thanks to the attentive, compassionate, and knowledgeable staff.

Every single person I have interacted with—from the reception team to the veterinary technicians and doctors—has played a vital role in the ongoing happiness and health of my dog. They treat every patient as if they were their own, and that kind of dedication is priceless. I can’t thank World of Animals enough for their extraordinary care.

This was our first visit to World Of Animals in South Philadelphia. Louie Does not like going to the vet The nurses and Doctor were exceptional in their understanding of His fright and fear. he was handled carefully and lovingly by the nurse. He is a cat who does not like to be picked up or held. The nurse used a very soft velvet blanket to pick him up. Surprisingly to me, he did not fight the nurse or try to jump out of her arms.. The doctor came in and gave him three shots very quickly. Again, I was surprised at how quickly he did the shots and Louie Did not try to escape. The two nurses Trimmed his nails and needed to Cut away matted fur. The doctor returned, and I thanked him for his services. He said to me that the nurses deserved the thanks. I have never heard a doctor say that before. It made me happy that he recognized The care and skill of the nurses. I highly recommend World Of Animals. We will return there again.
Feeling so positive after your visit is exactly what we hope for, Margo. We're delighted to know you had a great experience with us. Thank you for sharing your feedback!
Welcoming environment at WOA. The staff is friendly and welcoming. First time having a cat and visiting a vet. So far so good. Thank you to the staff there.
Wonderful people and place! They helped me with a sick kitten in a pinch!

I had to take my yellow lab there last Sunday she was bleeding from her mouth unfortunately it was cancer and I had to put her to sleep the Dr and his staff were very very nice and compassionate I can not thank them enough wonderful people I recommend them to anyone RIP RALLY

The staff here are always so kind, accommodating, and knowledgeable from the moment you call or step through the door. We’ve always had a pleasant experience and enjoy the staff. I know our dog is in good hands.
Dr. Stupine is my favorite vet of all time. Excellent bedside manner and passionate about his work but also very practical and forthright. I appreciate him, the staff and the practice very much!
Great place to take your pets for the right care! From vaccinations to anything your pet needs definitely recommend staff was awesome and dr was very knowledgeable and kind!!

World of Animals South Philadelphia is the best vet in Philly. All of the techs and vets got to know and clearly care about my dog. They consistently go out of their way to make my dog comfortable and give him the best care possible. I recommend them to all of my friends.
World of Animals took great care of Chai. Dr. Stupine followed up with a phone call the following evening to check on him. The staff is wonderful. I recommend this practice wholeheartedly.
Rehema had a lot of anxiety about getting her nails clipped but they were patient and gentle with her

We have taken our two cats to this vet and both experiences were great! One of our cats has a severe food allergy and the vet, Dr. Stupine, has diligently kept up with us and our cats progress for almost a year now! He is so informative and goes above and beyond what other vets have done in the past. Any tests we have had to have done for our cat were very reasonable and they don’t do anything unnecessary. The office staff is also very sweet and kind when we come in.  I would 100% recommend this vet to anyone!!
Knowing Sheila that your visit was a positive experience is exactly what we hope for. We're delighted to have been able to care for your pet. Thank you for sharing your feedback with us.

Knowing that your visit went smoothly is exactly what we aim for, Michael. We appreciate you taking the time to share your experience with us. If there's anything else we can do for you or your pet, please let us know.

Such a caring place and staff! They are very attentive and thorough! The doctors were very patient and kind, answering any and all questions we had. The nurses were quick and very knowledgeable with information. My wife and I will be using World of Animas South Philly for our pets care indefinitely. Truly grateful for this place and their staff

Took my grandmother's dog in and found out she had an ear infection. Everything was explained to me on what needed to be done to fix the problem and was giving the meds needed to get the infection in check and gone. The staff were nice and understanding of my grandmother's dog which wouldn't stop barking 90% of the time. Lol
Wonderful people! Excellent care!
It is always a pleasure to bring my cats to this business. They treat animals and humans well, genuinely care, and have reasonable pricing.
Clients like you are why we do this work, Yasmine. We're delighted to know you had a positive experience with us at World of Animals. Thank you for your kind words!

I had a wonderful experience bringing my new cat, George, here. Everyone was incredibly kind, welcoming, and easy to talk to. The staff took their time, answered all of my questions, and never made me feel rushed.

I was especially impressed with Dr. Stupine. After I got home, I called with a follow-up question, and he returned my call promptly. He then went above and beyond by sending me a detailed follow-up email with even more information, which I really appreciated.

It’s clear that the team genuinely cares about both their patients and their owners. I’m very grateful for the excellent care George received, and I’ll absolutely continue bringing both of my cats here. Highly recommend!
Great experience and excellent care for my dog

It’s very evident the entire staff is deeply in love with animals. The ladies at the front desk are very friendly, and Dr Stupine is fantastic helping and caring for two of my babies. It’s a bit expensive, however reasonable compared to other vets. I highly recommend this office, it is small enough where the visits feel personal.
Dr. Stupine and his staff are the best!!! We are dealing with significant health issues for our 8yo lab mix Jayda and they are on board with helping find solutions and getting her better!!!
World of Animals S Philly is amazing! We’ve been taking our dogs to WOA for a few years. Their services are affordable and they really care about my dog’s health needs. Thanks WOA! 🐾 🩷 Fiona

I had a great experience bringing my cat here for the first time. Every staff member I interacted with was very kind and helpful. Dr Stupine answered all of my questions and I was very satisfied with the care provided. I found the pricing to be reasonable. I will definitely be back!

Thank you, Harpreet, for your 5-star rating! We are thrilled to hear that you had a positive experience with World of Animals at South Philadelphia. We appreciate your trust in us for your pet's veterinary care.
Always a great experience for us! Everyone is kind and it is clear that animals are loved here.

Never been to a veterinarian that treated every single animal they see with the same love and compassion. They treat all our pets like they’re one of their family. You would never be disappointed bringing your pets here.

Me and my dog Juno love going to this animal hospital. They are always so kind to my dog and are excited about her growth, development, and over all well being. They are quick, efficient, and thorough. Juno has received all of her shots here, check ups, treatments and advice for a couple of rashes, a small benign bump. She will continue to be taken here for all her doggy medical care needs. I would recommend them to any and every pet owner. 💅✨
The Best Vets Ever! Love you guys ❤️
The doctors, assistant, and the employees are very professional, and caring toward our pets.
My appointment for my cat Ava was good.  they staff is very willing to accommodate any needs I have.

World of Animals is wonderful.  The full staff is professional and friendly.  Never a  long wait and everything is always explained to the nth degree so you don't leave with unanswered questions.  I always recommend the South Philly location to everyone I meet.

Everyone at World of Animals has shown so much compassion to our family and pup that was experiencing a lot of pain on her paw. Dr Stupine has gone above and beyond to provide a prompt treatment plan and has kept open communication the entire time. We are very appreciative of the entire team and know our pup is in great hands.
Love World of animals. The doctors and staff are wonderful and truly care about their patients
Always very friendly and professional
Everyone is always fantastic!
Doctor was nice, Communicated what vaccines were needed and what their for.

This new doctor, (vet) is GREAT! HE really listened to us and has called at least 3 times to check on Simba! So far it seems the treatment he recommended is the right choice!
Don't loose this doctor!
WoA team is always so great with our dog!
Helping this brave boy diagnose & treat his diabetes 💖

EXCELLENT. I had a semi-urgent medical issue (a ruptured anal gland), and the office gave me a same-day appointment. I got to the office early, and they took me early. The vet and staff were excellent. This isn't my primary vet, but after this visit, I will definitely be changing my office.
Khaleesi loves it here!  We couldn't ask for a better vet team!

We have been taking our pooch to W of A South Philly for about six years. All of the staff and the vets are very friendly and knowledgeable. The vets have all been very personable and really care about Copper. Copper always “enjoys” going in for his visits :)

I started taking my pups to world of animals after trying many veterinary clinics for over 11 yrs and none of them made my babies feel comfortable and safe, when i started going to world of animals they made every effort to have my babies trust thrm. I highly recommend them.

Great staff, polite and friendly! They listened to my concerns and took good care of my dog. Only negative thing: a little pricey (but I believe all philly vets are). Even though, I’d definitely come back and trust them with my pets!
Wanted to say Dr. Stupine was so helpful with explaining Lucy‘s condition. The whole staff is outstanding and helpful and so Pleasant.

After having failed my prior babies with vets that showed no interest, care, concern, ignored my questions and concerns but loved the money they got. When my dog passed away due to an overlooked condition,  even after mentioning it numerous time, I wasn't giving them the chance to do the same with my new baby. So I was on the search for a vet that would treat my fur son like he was their own. I found that in World of Animals South Phila. Each Dr I've had in the 5 years they've treated my Oswald were caring, knowledgeable,  listen and look into my concerns, reasonably prices and they take Care Credit. They are everything I was looking for.
Great first visit - staff was kind and caring. They took the time to get my dog’s history and do a thorough exam.
The Vet is awesome. Team is super awesome too

Dr. Stupine and the team at WOA were incredibly helpful during the palliative care of my cat, Louis. We always had a warm reception and our appointments ran on time. Dr. Stupine made Louis' care a priority and answered any questions confidently. WOA made us a priority when Louis' health declined, and reassured my husband and I during that difficult time. Thank you Dr. Stupine and Team for your care and expertise. ❤️

We had an unexpected emergency with our dog yesterday, and these guys stepped in and saved us from having to rush to an emergency vet. Their quick action and genuine care helped us through an incredibly stressful situation. I honestly can’t express how grateful I am for their support.
I’d honestly like to leave 50 stars above and beyond.
The doctors at world of animals are amazing!  We felt so welcomed and they truly cared about the well being of our dog.  Would recommend a million times over!

I have been bringing my senior Great Dane, Honey, to WOA in South Philly for over 5 years for a reason. The staff are incredible and treat my sweet ole gal like family, especially Debbie at the front desk, who is an angel in human form, and Dr Jeffrey Stupine, who is one of the most conscientious veterinarians I’ve ever met. Honey has a lot of fear and stress around vet visits due to her rescue history, but the entire staff at WOA go out of their way to show Honey nothing but love and patience and meet her where she is to make her feel safe. The veterinarians and the vet techs are incredibly knowledgeable and compassionate people. I couldn’t be happier with the treatment and care WOA has provided Honey these last 5 years. I’m beyond grateful to have such a high quality veterinary clinic in my neighborhood!

We recently moved to Philly, and asked neighbors for vet recommendations. A few different folks told us they go to and love World of Animals, so we decided to give it a go.

To be clear, the reception staff and tech we worked with were very kind. My biggest problem was with the vet. I asked her a number of questions regarding my 1.5yo dog. One of these questions was about gentle leader leashes and when to start introducing our dog to going on runs with us. Her response was appalling: “I don’t have a dog, so you should probably ask a trainer about that. I don’t know.” Imagine if you went to a pediatrician and asked them a question about your child, and they said, “I don’t have children, so I don’t know.” I was pretty frustrated with her response, as well as the briefness of her exam with my dog. I will be taking my dog elsewhere for a much better and more thorough health experience.
Everyone here always takes great care of my pup!
Wonderful team! They are welcoming and kind and really care about animals.  10 out of 10!

Beans has been going to WoA for two years and they are extremely considerate with him being leash reactive. They allow me to go into the room with him, hold him while they conduct the exam, and always listen to my concerns, i any. Their pricing is far and they are always on time and the facility is very clean. Thank you up Debbie and the rest of the staff for an incredible experience!

A welcoming office with a friendly staff. My little guy was nervous when we first arrived but Dr Stupine and his tech made him feel at ease during his checkup. I’d almost say by the end of the exam he enjoyed being there. If you’re looking for a new team to care for your baby, make your appointment with World of Animal South Philly now!
Very friendly and efficient. Great experience for my dog and myself
I was expecting to see my vet who has been taking care of my baby her whole life. There’s new faces all the time and I appreciate the consistency of seeing the same doctor.

This is the first time that I've been to a vet in years where it actually just felt nice. Where it felt more like a community. Where it felt more like going to the vet when I was a kid. I got to stay with my dog. everyone was sweet and helpful it was easy to make an appointment. The staff is absolutely wonderful. Happy to have switched over to this event and to bring all my other babies there
The people are very friendly and my dogs love them.  The service is fast and it is very easy to make an appointment.
Overall people were friendly.  Vet was kind and good with my cat.  And price is totally reasonable
They always take excellent care of my 2 kitties: 1 who's a bit shy and the other who's a bit aggressive when not in familiar spaces.

Extremely friendly staff. I always feel like my pets are truly being taken care of and loved. Front desk staff is amazing and they are all vey kind and personable. Vet staff always happily answers any of the 100 questions I might have, no matter how silly.

World Of Animals is such a wonderful place to bring your pets.  They genuinely are concerned about your pets well-being.  The Staff is concerned and knowledgeable.  The Vets are confident in their skills and are personable and professional.  We have had very good experiences at each visit.

Coming from a small town vet and moving into the city, I was nervous about finding a vet that still had that small-town feel. From check-in to being seen by the vet tech and the vet, I could tell this place cares about their clients and I knew I made the right choice. Also reasonable prices!
Love this place and the staff! Everyone was nice and pleasant and friendly! And they make you feel welcomed!
They were very helpful with getting me a wellness appointment and arranging an earlier surgery date at another one of their offices for my cat, who needed a cleaning and an extraction. Thank you!!
Amazing service, straightforward service, very nice customer service and all around amazing vet would recommend.

We just got finished with our checkup today and it was the most painless and comfortable experience (as far as a vet visit with 2 cats goes!)
You can just tell that each and every staff member really cares. They’re very sweet, personable, and professional. Even the nurses were worried about my anxiety with my cats getting their usual vaccines, which they didn’t have to do. 😂
We got some good advice on how to proceed with their health, and it’s a big comfort knowing that they are fully stocked on the prescription food that I otherwise would have no idea how to get.
Thanks, all!
What a great place ...you can tell they care about the furbabies...a new client in us🙂 …

I love this practice! I've been bringing my dog here since I moved to South Philly in 2018. They're so thoughtful, careful, excellent with both pets and their owners - they've guided us through lots of care and health issues over the years. My dog pulls me up the steps to run inside, because she knows she'll get so much affection (and treats) there.
just love my new Dr for my leo!thank you so much!

My Piper likes it there and we're very happy with it also very convenient for us we do wish we didn't have to travel so far to have a dental we don't have means of getting there and we thought it was kind of high he's an old dog and I'm a little Berry on putting him under so if you have any comments or any ideas please don't hesitate send me an email thank you
Dr. Wrigley is brilliant and compassionate.  The staff members are beyond amazing!!  We just love the team at World of Animals.

I have been taking my pup there since we got her at 12 weeks of age. Everybody there has been amazing from front desk to the vet, Dr Flasik. I probably called them dozens time for any worries that I have about my pups They are very quick to respond for all my concerns. They’re very friendly and kind to our pup that make her always happy to go see them.
5 stars all and all !!
Very friendly. Very helpful. The front desk crew is wonderful and Dr. Flasik always explains things well and provides useful options.
We always love bringing our cat, Monster, to World of Animals for a checkup. The staff are sooo friendly and helpful.

Everyone at World of Animals truly loves and cares for your pets! The doctors and nurses provide you with all of the information you need. They have answered any question I have ever asked of them. They want to make sure your pets have a positive/non-stressful experience at the vet so they even encouraged us to come in and say hi / get a treat whenever we are nearby! The doctor recommended some oral work for both of my my cats but wasn't pushy or judgmental about it. They are so good at making sure my dog is comfortable when we come in for vaccinations and even offered some prescription meds to help in the future (free of charge)! Everyone is so lovely who works here! When I'm out walking my dog and we see someone from WoA they always say hi and greet us as if we were friends. I highly recommend bringing your pets here!
Truly the most wonderful vet experience every time I go in there

My dog Bruce absolutely loves coming to World of Animals South Philadelphia. Dr. Wrigley, Erin, and the whole staff are always kind and informative. Everything is always explained clearly, with all options for care presented. I feel lucky to have such a great vet so close to home!

2025 update, the staff has changed and Dr.Flasik and Debbie and the entire crew are wonderful. My senior dog receives excellent and thoughtful care every time we visit. Cannot recommend this practice enough!
